intro.titulo:
The balance
between the classic 911
and the modern Porsche.
parrafos: The Porsche 911 Carrera 4S of the 997.1 generation represents one of the most attractive points in recent history of 911. It retains a direct and mechanical driving experience, but incorporates the level of performance, stability and everyday usability expected from a modern Porsche.

Its flat-six naturally aspirated engine of 3,8 liters and 355 hp is associated with a six-speed manual transmission, a combination especially valued by enthusiasts in a market increasingly dominated by automatic transmissions and engines overfed.
intro.cita: This unit adds the presence of the Carrera 4S, with body and all-wheel drive, to a long history at Valentin Motors since 2022, very well maintained and with a negative Bore Scoring check.

parrafos: The flat-six atmospheric 3,8 liters responds linearly, gaining intensity as the revs rise and maintaining a direct relationship between accelerator, sound and thrust. It delivers 355 hp without turbo or supercharger involved.

The six-speed manual gearbox allows the engine to be exploited with precision and turns each gear change into part of the experience. The all-wheel drive adds mobility and poise, especially when exiting curves, without eliminating the rear character of the 911. The PASM combines sporty response with reasonable road use.

opinion.bio: More than 25 years of experience with collectible Porsche. He has supervised hundreds of sales and purchase operations of special vehicles, with a special focus on 911 of analog generations.
opinion.intro: "It's a unit for anyone looking to drive a 911, not just own it."
parrafos: The 997 Carrera 4S manual is one of those Porsche whose appeal has grown over time. It maintains the size, visibility and mechanical feel that many enthusiasts associate with a truly usable 911, but offers enough performance and stability to enjoy it on any type of road.

Manual shifting is an essential part of its personality. It forces you to work with the engine, allows you to choose the exact speed and reinforces the connection between driver and car. It is precisely this configuration that is gaining more market among enthusiasts, in the face of a market increasingly dominated by automatic transmissions and supercharged engines.

The body of the 4S gives it a special presence, while the all-wheel drive provides security without turning it into a distant car. It is a unit to drive, keep and enjoy, with the added value of a known history at Valentin Motors since 2022 and a negative Bore Scoring check.
